screens.notes: The full picture and the throttle controls: budget tiles, pace, the last hour by 5-min bucket, consumers with their check cadence, and the slow-down rules.

sampleData: Healthy: REST 4,112/5,000 left, GraphQL 4,690, resets 14:00 in 38m; this hour 888 calls = Harnu 582 (missions 412, PR Stack 96, Review 38, Cleanup 22, Steward 14) + outside 306. Low: REST 640 left (87% used), GraphQL 3,980, reset in 21m; 4,360 calls = Harnu 2,310 (missions 1,840 incl. 610 for 3 delivered missions, PR Stack 310, Review 84, Cleanup 46, Steward 30) + outside 2,050; throttling since 13:39 at the 15% threshold. Exhausted: REST 0 left, reset 14:00 in 12m; 5,000 calls = Harnu 2,620 + outside 2,380.

flows.title: B — from the pill to the details

decisions: 2026-11-02: delivered missions are never checked on GitHub, at any budget (operator's choice in the delivery questions). D's switch became 'Check delivered missions' (off) under its own Missions heading; B's low-state note dropped the delivered-missions clause. Both screens keep the approval because the operator chose this exact change.

2026-11-02 (operator, amendment 1) — AC-9: on a gh rate-limit message, poll `gh api rate_limit` at once (free); only a bucket at remaining 0 makes the state `exhausted`; otherwise it is GitHub's secondary limit and throttled reads pause for 60 s (or the Retry-After gh prints) without changing the state, exposed as `secondaryPauseUntil`; writes stay unthrottled.

2026-11-02 (operator, amendment 2) — AC-6 (U2): the Settings pane uses the app's real ToggleSwitch, SegmentedControl and SettingHint; mockup D's controls are approximations and do not bind the pixel diff.
